branchName.instructions: Prefix branches with feat/ or fix/ and a short kebab-case description (e.g. fix/severity-anchor). No personal prefixes.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits with a scope, matching repo history: feat(finalcode): vN.N.N — <summary> for releases; fix(<area>): <what changed> otherwise.

pullRequest.instructions: Describe the change and why. Per CONTRIBUTING, changes belong in skills/finalcode/ only. Include a Test plan section listing the validate script results.
